ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As illustrated in the diagram, a street lamp (point O) is 6.4m above the ground. Xiao Ming, who is 1.6m tall, walks from point A, which is 9m away from the base of the street lamp (point P), along a straight line in the direction of AP to point D. When he stops, the length of his shadow under the street lamp has reduced by 1.8m. Calculate the distance Xiao Ming has walked.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the given information, we have $OP=64m$, $AB=DE=1.6m$, $AP=9m$, $DF=AC-1.8$,\\
$\because$ $\angle OPC=\angle BAC$, $\angle BCA=\angle OCP$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle BCA\sim\triangle OCP$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{BA}{OP}=\frac{AC}{PC}$, that is $\frac{1.6}{6.4}=\frac{AC}{AC+9}$,\\
$\therefore$ $AC=3$,\\
$\therefore$ $DF=AC-1.8=3-1.8=1.2\text{(m)}$,\\
$\because$ $\angle OPC=\angle EDF=90^\circ$, $\angle EFD=\angle OFP$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle EFD\sim\triangle OFP$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{DE}{OP}=\frac{DF}{PF}$, that is $\frac{1.6}{6.4}=\frac{1.2}{PF}$,\\
$\therefore$ $PF=4.8$,\\
$\therefore$ $AD=AP-PF+DF=9-4.8+1.2=\boxed{5.4}\text{(m)}$,\\
